<div class="card-body">
'''Deflector Shield Generators''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ディフレクター・シールド発生装置</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">３フォース消費して任意のスター・デストロイヤーに配備する。装甲値に２を加える。もしその宇宙船が対：損耗を持つなら、その値に２を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Deflector-Shield-Generators-PSA-151452820.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">スター・デストロイヤーの上部に設置された発生装置は、飛来物や敵の砲火を跳ね返すエネルギー・シールドを発生させる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Deflector shield generator.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on any Star Destroyer. Adds 2 to armor. If that starship has immunity to attrition, also adds 2 to that value.

'''Lore:'''
Generators mounted atop a Star Destroyer produce an energy shield that turns back incoming objects and enemy fire.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Deflector Shield Generators]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
